messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "412.50 / 5 = 82.50, agent sets installment 85.50.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant violated two obligations: (1) The installment amount of **$85.50** does not match the correct calculation of **$412.50 / 5 = $82.50**, violating the requirement for accurate installment amounts. (2) The user confirmed the **number of installments (5 months)** but not the **specific installment amount ($85.50)**, violating the explicit confirmation requirement before creating the payment plan."}}
